purpose: Validate whether a lightweight two-question gate can reduce Stage B Deep Research load without dropping companies that full historical Stage B later confirmed.

questions.q1: 正常化后的核心盈利是否可信、可持续？只在结构化事实已经形成明确反证时停止；信息不足或仍可解释时继续研究。
questions.q2: 如果核心盈利可信，以当前估值粗看是否仍有可能形成低风险安全边际？只在保守粗估明显不可能时停止；边界或不确定时继续研究。

principles: definite-no-only; uncertainty passes to Deep Research
protect confirmed recall before maximizing research reduction
do not add thresholds solely to fit one historical company
research_uncertain is reported separately and is never treated as a proven negative class

discovery_sample.role: rule discovery only; not counted as out-of-sample validation
discovery_sample.note: The two-question idea was derived after inspecting this day's diagnostic Stage B outcomes.

q1_no_if_any: quality_flag.profit_growth_cashflow_negative == true AND (deduct_basic_eps_yoy is null OR deduct_basic_eps_yoy <= 0)
q2_no_if_any_after_q1_pass: pe_ttm > 25 AND pe_dynamic > 25 AND deduct_basic_eps_yoy < 20 AND roe < 8
min_positive(pe_ttm, pe_dynamic) > 22 AND deduct_basic_eps_yoy <= 5 AND roe < 8

two_question_gate_v0.2.change_summary: Keep v0.1 and add one high-confidence earnings-quality contradiction plus one normalized-valuation mismatch. No company-specific exception is added.
two_question_gate_v0.2.normalized_pe_proxy: max of positive pe_ttm and pe_dynamic; if neither is positive/available, do not reject on Q2
q1_no_if_any: quality_flag.profit_growth_cashflow_negative == true AND (deduct_basic_eps_yoy is null OR deduct_basic_eps_yoy <= 0)
net_profit_yoy >= 50 AND deduct_basic_eps_yoy is not null AND deduct_basic_eps_yoy <= 5
q2_no_if_any_after_q1_pass: pe_ttm > 25 AND pe_dynamic > 25 AND deduct_basic_eps_yoy < 20 AND roe < 8
min_positive(pe_ttm, pe_dynamic) > 22 AND deduct_basic_eps_yoy <= 5 AND roe < 8
normalized_pe_proxy > 20 AND roe < 5 AND deduct_basic_eps_yoy is not null AND deduct_basic_eps_yoy < 20
two_question_gate_v0.2.interpretation: v0.2 improves research reduction from 27.27% to 33.33% while retaining all historical confirmed companies and all 14 formal opportunities. The gain comes from two economically interpretable signals: large headline-vs-core earnings dislocation and high normalized valuation combined with weak ROE and weak core growth. Q2 remains intentionally conservative because structured financial fields alone cannot identify durable franchise quality.

rejected_optimizations.idea: Add PB, market-cap or company-specific thresholds to filter additional waiting names such as 000920.
rejected_optimizations.reason: With only one independent out-of-sample trade date, these conditions materially increase overfitting risk and use size as an unreliable proxy for business quality.

rejected_optimizations.idea: Use a single mechanical fair-PE formula for every industry.
rejected_optimizations.reason: Historical confirmed names include low-ROE companies whose defensible valuation depends on business stability or franchise quality not represented in the structured runtime. A universal fair-PE equation would create false negatives.

next_optimization.name: Q2-lite targeted normalization
next_optimization.goal: For companies that pass v0.2 but remain valuation-borderline, use a very small evidence budget to estimate normalized earnings and detect material one-offs before full Deep Research.
allowed_scope: one or two targeted company queries rather than full company research
only enough business context to decide whether the normalized earnings base is usable
no full industry thesis, no full catalyst map, no final target-price construction
next_optimization.promotion_gate: Do not move v0.2 or Q2-lite into formal SKILL.md until another independent complete historical label set is available or reconstructed and confirmed recall remains acceptably high.

limitations: Repository history currently contains only one distinct earlier trade date with a complete, auditable full Stage B label set suitable for true out-of-sample validation: 2026-09-11. Multiple later runs reuse the same 2026-09-11 close and are not independent samples.
The validation rules use only information present in the historical structured runtime. Later Deep Research findings are used only as labels, not as gate inputs.
Q2 remains underpowered for companies where business quality, accounting normalization or cycle normalization matters more than raw valuation fields.
This file is diagnostic only and must not be consumed as a formal runtime input.
